planets.name: HIP 65 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HIP 65 A with a 0.981-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HIP 65 A b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HIP 65 A. Its orbit and size follow Nielsen et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
